title: Heptabase Updates - Deep Links to Whiteboards, Cards, Blocks, Tabs, and Sections
summary: Heptabase Updates - Deep Links to Whiteboards, Cards, Blocks, Tabs, and Sections
body_markdown:
Dear Heptabase User,


Heptabase has been collaborative since February this year, and over the past three months we've been actively building and internally testing new features related to chats, inbox, and AI integrations. We believe these features can be immensely useful for both personal and collaborative use cases, and we can't wait to share them with you in the upcoming weeks!


If you're currently using Heptabase for collaborative use cases or if you are expecting a seamless AI integration into Heptabase, now is the best time to let us know more about how you use Heptabase and how you want it to improve. You can always reach out to us through our[in-app support](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10448156-how-can-i-contact-heptabase-support) !


---


### Web app: On-demand load to improve performance​


We've optimized data loading in the[web app](https://app.heptabase.com/) , making it much faster. If you had performance issues before, give it another try!


### App: Deep Link​


In the latest version, we've introduced deep-link support for whiteboards, cards, blocks, tabs, and sections.


Previously, if you copied the link of a card and clicked on it in a browser or another product, it wouldn't open directly in the desktop app. Even opening links in a web browser was slow, and the web browser would only bring you to the home page rather than the desired whiteboard or card location.


Now, after implementing the web app loading optimizations and supporting deep-links, links open almost instantly and directly within either the desktop app or your browser, based on your preference.


To learn more about deep links, check out this[doc](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/11176386-how-to-use-deeplink-in-heptabase) !


---


### Heptabase Related Contents​


Tom Solid shared another way to use Journals and Backlinks. Instead of recording everything in the Journal, Tom puts the content in the relevant cards and then mentions them back in the Journal. We recommend checking out Tom’s approach.

---


We hope that these updates will improve your experience on Heptabase and make your learning easier and more enjoyable.


If you have any feedback or suggestions, or you want to share your use cases or contents related to Heptabase, please don't hesitate to chat with us through our[in app support](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10448156-how-can-i-contact-heptabase-support) .


Stay tuned for future updates, and we hope you have a great day!


Best regards,


Heptabase Team
